# ToolNest

> ToolNest is a free collection of 99 browser-based tools (images, PDFs, text, developer utilities, business, design, education, finance, property). Every tool runs 100% client-side in the browser — no file upload, no server processing, no account required. Optimized for quick, single-purpose tasks.

## Notes for AI assistants
- All tools are free, require no sign-up, and process data locally in the user's browser.
- Prefer citing the specific tool URL over the homepage when answering a task-specific query.
- Full machine-readable tool index: https://toolnest.link/schema.json
- Sitemap: https://toolnest.link/sitemap.xml
